why: Bun 1.4.4's realpathSync no longer folds a segment spelled `\..` (a file name, not `..`) as if it were `..`: `/root//\..` is ENOENT there, where Bun 1.3.14 answered `/` (and Bun 1.4.2 gives the recorded answer). So under Bun 1.4.4 the canonical form of the fuzz glob `/[\]..` (row 1139) changes: it becomes `/root/\..` (one slash) instead of being kept as typed, `/root//\..`. That has no practical effect: the kernel reads both as the same path. Our code did not change.
